newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Algeria's Ouyahia in Zimbabwe for G-15 meeting.
newsitem.headline: Algeria's Ouyahia in Zimbabwe for G-15 meeting.

text.p: Algerian Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia arrived in Harare on Saturday to attend a three-day meeting of a Group of 15 (G-15) developing countries aimed at promoting trade among them.
Ouyahia joined Malaysia's Mathir Mohamad, India's H.D. Deve Gowda and Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak who arrived earlier amid unusually tight security at Harare international airport.
Organisers of the G-15 countries said on Friday eight leaders had confirmed their attendance at the summit starting on Sunday but declined to name them citing security reasons.
The leaders will look at ways of forging a common front among Africa, Asian and Latin American states to give them a stronger voice in a world moving towards free trade.
Algeria is a founder member of the G-15 which also includes Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Egypt, India, Indonesia, Jamaica, Malaysia, Nigeria, Senegal, Peru, Venezuela, Yugoslavia and Zimbabwe.
